neighbours.label: verbs of objecting/opposing (' object', ' objected', ' opposed') as a stance taken on a proposal
fire: Most of the neighbours did not object to the new playground.
Several senators objected to the proposed tax increase.
The union strongly opposed the plan to close the factory.
If anyone wishes to object, they should speak now.
Her parents never objected when she chose to study art.
Local farmers opposed the new highway through their fields.
The lawyer rose to object to the question.
Many residents were opposed to building the casino.
quiet: Most of the neighbours did not notice the new playground.
Several senators discussed the proposed tax increase.
The union carefully studied the plan to close the factory.
If anyone wishes to speak, they should raise a hand now.
Her parents were happy when she chose to study art.
Local farmers watched the new highway through their fields.
The lawyer rose to ask another question.
Many residents were excited about building the casino.
